policy: Explicit preferred display spellings, reviewed against complete JMdict entries, readings and word meanings. Never infer a headword from homophones alone. Usually-kana, loanword and ambiguous multiple-kanji uses remain unchanged unless explicitly reviewed. Original analyzed headwords remain the basis for reference grading.
